name: qoder-agent-bridge
description: Bridge Qoder into your agent workflow through Skills and CLI.

scripts.skill:check: pnpm skill:artifacts:check && pnpm skill:build && node --check skill/qoder-agent/scripts/run_qoder.mjs && node --check skill/qoder-agent/scripts/qoder_worktree.mjs && node --check skill/qoder-agent/scripts/qoder_agent_task.mjs && pnpm test && if python3 -c 'import yaml' >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 /Users/lei/.codex/skills/.system/skill-creator/scripts/quick_validate.py skill/qoder-agent && python3 /Users/lei/.codex/skills/.system/skill-creator/scripts/quick_validate.py skill/qoder-worker; else node scripts/validate_skill.mjs skill/qoder-agent && node scripts/validate_skill.mjs skill/qoder-worker; fi
